subject: FIGHT
text: The FIGHT battle command attacks a target, but attacks nothing if the selected target is destroyed.

evidence.quote: FIGHT allows your character to select a target to attack (if the target is destroyed, they will attack nothing).

subject: MAGIC
text: The MAGIC command allows a character to cast a purchased spell, expending one charge from that level's reserves.

evidence.quote: MAGIC will allow that character to choose a spell from their list of bought spells to use (each use will take a charge away from your reserves for that level).

subject: DRINK
text: The DRINK command allows a character to use a Heal Potion or Pure Potion on themselves or a teammate during battle.

evidence.quote: DRINK will let your character to use a Heal Potion OR Pure Potion on themselves or a teammate during battle.

subject: RUN
text: The RUN command attempts to flee battle, though all bosses and certain enemies cannot be escaped.

evidence.quote: RUN is what you will select if you wish to have a character attempt to escape a battle (note that all Bosses and some enemies are inescapable!).

subject: Coneria
text: Traveling north from Coneria through plains, a forest, a swamp, and a final forest leads to the Temple of Fiends.

evidence.quote: You will need to head out of town and start your trek to the north....You will continue along the small plains area to pass through a forest and then...a swamp before entering one final forest to get to the building looming in...the distance... THE TEMPLE OF FIENDS!
